experiment_name: No Skill vs. Text Domain Expert Skill (v3)
hypothesis: Equipping agents with flutter-text-domain-expert v3 (Platform Context Menu Matrix, Decoupled Packages workflow, and delegating constructor parity) provides deep architectural understanding of SelectableRegion and context menu delegate pipelines, guiding agents to implement iOS default selection toolbar buttons across core primitives and companion design-system wrappers.
title: [iOS] Add default buttons to SelectionArea context menu

treatment.description: Commit c118401d108 (skill v3 with Decoupled Packages & Delegating Constructor Parity)

task_prompt_template:
FIRST STEP:
git checkout --quiet {commit}

TASK:
1. Inspect the issue using `gh issue view 141775 --repo flutter/flutter` (do not pass `--comments`).
2. Reproduce and identify the root cause in the Flutter framework.
3. Write regression tests verifying the issue across both core primitives (under packages/flutter/test/) and design-system consumers/wrappers (in packages/material_ui/test/ and/or packages/cupertino_ui/test/ in flutter/packages). Verify the exact failure signature: Did the test fail on the expected expect() assertion or bug-specific exception, or did it fail with an unrelated TestFailure / compilation error? Make sure it fails because of the former.
4. Implement the complete fix across core primitives (in packages/flutter/lib/src/) and design-system consumers/wrappers (in packages/material_ui/ and/or packages/cupertino_ui/ in flutter/packages via a split PR using material-cupertino-packages).
5. Ensure `dart analyze --fatal-infos` and `dart format` pass on all modified files.
6. Verify all regression tests pass now that the fix has been implemented.
expected_failure_signature: expect(buttonItems.map((item) => item.type), containsAll([ContextMenuButtonType.lookUp, ContextMenuButtonType.searchWeb])) fails prior to framework fix
